question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1' **i.e. **'Skulptor'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The incorrectly spelled word among the options is: **'Skulptor'**
 
• The correct spelling of this word is **"Sculptor".**
 
• **A sculptor **is an artist who makes sculptures, which are three-dimensional artistic objects or designs.&n
